text:
Ashley: Heads-up — saw a weird pattern in the 10k shadow sample for the longdoc slice: near-duplicate outputs across variants, then abrupt score flips. feels like an "echo" effect from KV warmup. :thinking_face:
Priyanka: Can you paste a quick example and the metric trace?
Ashley: Example snippet: same prompt repeated across sessions -> v2 returns stable summary, v3 returns repeated slightly different phrasings and the rerank score oscillates. echo_ratio (near-duplicate fraction) jumped. Link to anonymized trace: <redacted>
Ben: "slice-echo" makes sense. We saw something similar once with cached prefixes + micro-batching. What's the magnitude?
Ashley: echo_ratio ~ 0.18 baseline in shadow but spike to 0.31 on the longdoc cohort during warmup bursts. delta_mrr for that cohort is -0.045 (v3 vs baseline).
Priyanka: Oof. That delta_mrr is above our usual rollback sensitivity. I'd prefer an automated guard but staged: detect in shadow, then quiet 0.5% canary, then 1% pilot. Also need cooldown to prevent thrashing.
Ben: Agreed. Proposal: auto-fallback if echo_ratio > 0.25 AND delta_mrr < -0.03 over a 30m window, with a 60m cooldown and route traffic back to prev-stable.
Maria: Also add sample deduping in the eval harness (dedupe by user-prompt hash) so we don't get false positives from repeat submissions.
Ben: Draft fallback policy (pseudo-config):
```
fallback_policy {
  metric: "echo_ratio"
  comparator: ">"
  threshold: "0.25"
  secondary_metric: "delta_mrr"
  secondary_comparator: "<"
  secondary_threshold: "-0.03"
  window: "30m"
  cooldown: "60m"
  action: "route->prev-stable"
}
```
Ashley: Also want an observability hook: when triggered, capture 500 sample input/outputs for the window and push to S3 + post a short digest to #incidents quiet channel.
ops-bot: Incident rule ENG-ML-ECHO-1 created: alert when auto-fallback invoked >= 2 times in 24h.
Priyanka: Good. Who owns implementation and the eval changes?
Ashley: Assigning: @Ben for rollout gating rule implementation, @Maria for eval harness & dedupe. I'll open a promotion ticket with steps and attach the shadow logs.
Ben: On it — will implement policy and a canary job. Will post PR & config diff here when ready.
Maria: I'll add dedupe + sample export and run a 24h shadow with more verbose logging.
Ashley: Plan: 24h shadow with extra logs, then 0.5% quiet canary next Tues, monitor for 48h, then decide.
Priyanka: Thanks — good plan. :thumbsup:
Ben: Quick Q — should the fallback route to prev-stable or to a quantized variant? I vote prev-stable for safety.
Ashley: Prev-stable. We can consider a measured quantized fallback later if prev-stable capacity is constrained.
Priyanka: One more: add a lightweight assay in the console dashboard showing echo_ratio trend per slice (daily and 1h).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: #eng-ml reminder "review ECHO-1 shadow results" set for 1712310000.
Ashley: Thanks team :raised_hands:
